text: Okay... hmm. I checked my email, but didn't see anything with that exact ID right off the bat. I usually just keep track of the confirmation number. Let me see... ah, I think it's #W0000001. Is that the one you need?
zh: 好的……嗯。我检查了我的邮箱，但一开始没看到任何带有那个确切 ID 的东西。我通常只记确认号。让我看看……啊，我想是 #W0000001。是这个您需要的吗？
